newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles Myer says supermarkets strong.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles Myer says supermarkets strong.

text.p: Coles Myer Ltd said on Thursday its supermarkets lifted sales and earnings growth in the 26 weeks to January 26, 1997.
"Supermarkets again recorded strong sales and earnings growth, in the face of an aggressively competitive market," Coles Myer said in a commentary accompanying its first half results.
Supermarket sales rose 11.4 percent to A$4.61 billion and earnings before interest and tax increased 13.1 percent ot A$145.6 million.

"Sales have increased by 40 percent over the last three years, with steady growth in market share, and earnings over the same period have increased by 43 percent," Coles Myer said in a statement with its half year results.
"Earnings growth for the remainder of the year is expected to match sales growth," it said.
This would be assisted by initiatives such as expansion of new formats, more flexible enterprise agreements and extended trading hours.
